Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤯. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his voice firm but gentle 💊.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 🤝."

JACK:
"I don't want to take it. I don't want to be a prisoner in my own mind 🚫."

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, you're not thinking clearly. You need to take your medication to manage your symptoms 🤯."

JACK:
"I don't need your help. I can take care of myself 💪."

DR. SMITH:
"Fine, if you won't take it, I'll take it for you 🤷‍♂️."

Dr. Smith forces the medication into Jack's mouth, and he swallows it down 💦.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring blankly at a file on his desk 📁. He looks up, and suddenly, Jack is standing in front of him, looking perfectly normal 👍.

JACK:
"Thanks for taking care of me, Doc 🙏."

DR. SMITH:
"Ah, Jack... I think you're just a figment of my imagination 🤯."

JACK:
"What do you mean? I'm right here in front of you 👀."

DR. SMITH:
"I mean, I'm the one who's been pretending to be you all along 🤦‍♂️."

Jack looks confused, but Dr. Smith just shrugs and smiles maniacally 😈.

DR. SMITH:
"I've been living in this asylum for years, pretending to be a doctor, and you're the only one who's ever called me out on it 🤯."

Jack looks around the room, and suddenly, the walls begin to distort and blur, revealing the true nature of the asylum 🌐.

JACK:
"You're the one who's been sick all along, Doc 🤕."

Dr. Smith's smile falters, and he looks at Jack with a mixture of fear and realization 😨.

DR. SMITH:
"Maybe you're right... maybe I am the one who's been living in a fantasy world 🌈."

The camera zooms out, and we see the asylum for what it truly is: a prison, a place where the mentally ill are locked away, and the doctors are just as broken as their patients 🚫.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
